description: Illustrative terminal conversation. Real local routing tests; no live email integration or deployment.

scenes.label: Understand
scenes.prompt: @fde Our customer sorts support emails by hand. Help me improve it.
scenes.answer: Where does the team lose time: reading emails, choosing a team, or waiting for replies?

scenes.label: Agree the work
scenes.prompt: Choosing a team. Start with billing, login problems and outages.
scenes.answer: We can route those three types to the right team. Anything unclear stays with a person. Shall I build that?

scenes.label: Build
scenes.prompt: Yes. Build the routing part first.
scenes.answer: Added triage.js: billing to Billing, login problems to IT, outages to Support. Next: test the routes.

scenes.label: Switch customer
scenes.prompt: @fde Save my place. I have a website meeting with my other client.
scenes.answer: Saved: email routing is built; tests are next. Switching to your other client's notes for the meeting.

scenes.label: Resume and test
scenes.prompt: @fde Back to the email project. Continue where we stopped.
scenes.answer: Resumed the tests. All 6 local checks pass, including sending unknown types to a person.

scenes.label: Prepare rollout
scenes.prompt: Can the customer use it now?
scenes.answer: The routing code passes. We still need to connect their inbox and test with approved sample emails before going live.

scenes.label: Prepare handover
scenes.prompt: Prepare the handover and save what is left.
scenes.answer: Draft saved: team routes, manual review and how to stop routing. Next session: connect and test the inbox.
